name: samaaro-event-management
description: Manage Samaaro events and admins from ChatGPT: list and search events, view event reports, expenses and ROI, create, clone and update events, and manage admin access.

interface.longDescription:
Samaaro is an event management platform. This plugin lets Samaaro super-admins manage their events from ChatGPT in plain language.

- Find events with filters for status, event type and name.
- See an event's analytics report: tickets, RSVPs, check-ins, new vs. returning attendees and UTM sources.
- Review an event's expenses and their approval status.
- Compare event ROI for a date range with the same period last year.
- Create, clone and update events, and activate or deactivate them.
- Manage admins: create them, block or unblock them, give or remove access to an event, and send event invitation emails.

Actions that create or change data ask for confirmation first. Sign in with your Samaaro super-admin account; the plugin acts with your permissions.
defaultPrompt: Compare this quarter's event ROI with the same quarter last year
Which expenses for my latest event are still pending approval?

positive.description: List upcoming events using the status filter.
positive.prompt: Show my upcoming events in Samaaro.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_events with status 'upcoming' and lists the upcoming events (for example FutureConnect Leadership Summit 2026 on 29 December 2026) with title, dates, type and status, without showing internal IDs.

positive.description: Find an event by name and show its analytics report.
positive.prompt: Show me the analytics report for the Abu Dhabi Fintech Conference.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Abu Dhabi Fintech Conference by name, then returns its report: ticket data, RSVP responses, check-in stats, new vs. returning attendees and UTM sources.

positive.description: Review an event's expenses and their approval status.
positive.prompt: Which expenses for the Abu Dhabi Fintech Conference are still pending approval?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the event, lists its expenses with category, amount and status, and highlights the ones with status 'pending'.

positive.description: Compare ROI for a date range with the same period last year.
positive.prompt: Compare our event ROI from January to June 2026 with the same months last year.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_event_roi_overview for 1 January to 30 June 2026 and reports event count, check-in rate and email open rate for both periods with the percentage change.

positive.description: Search events by part of their name.
positive.prompt: Find my events with 'Summit' in the name.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching events, such as AI Summit and FutureConnect Leadership Summit 2026, with their dates and status.

negative.description: General event-planning advice that does not need the user's Samaaro data.
negative.prompt: What are some tips for running a successful conference?

negative.description: Events on another platform the plugin does not connect to.
negative.prompt: Show me the events I created on Eventbrite.

negative.description: Payment actions the plugin does not support.
negative.prompt: Refund the ticket payment for one of my attendees.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: find and filter Samaaro events, view event reports, expenses and ROI, create, clone and update events, and manage admin access. Changes always ask for confirmation first.
